description: Consolidated summary figure: TWIST1 variant architecture, panel diagnostic yield and CNV size distribution
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1,1.15], hspace=0.42, wspace=0.26)

# --- Panel A: TWIST1 protein map with P/LP missense clustering ---
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
L=202
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((1,0.35),L,0.3,fc="#e8e8e8",ec="k",lw=0.8))
doms=[("basic",108,120,"#f4a582"),("helix 1",121,133,"#b2182b"),("loop",134,147,"#fddbc7"),
      ("helix 2",148,160,"#b2182b"),("Twist box",183,192,"#2166ac")]
for n,s,e,c in doms:
    axA.add_patch(Rectangle((s,0.35),e-s+1,0.3,fc=c,ec="k",lw=0.7))
    axA.text((s+e)/2,0.72,n,ha="center",fontsize=8,rotation=0)
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((81,0.35),9,0.3,fc="none",ec="green",lw=1.6,ls="--"))
axA.text(85,0.18,"Gly repeat 81-89\n(gnomAD lcr artefact)",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="green")
axA.annotate("", xy=(108,0.30), xytext=(160,0.30), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->",color="k",lw=1.2))
axA.text(134,0.08,"bHLH 108-160: 42/44 (95.5%) of P/LP missense\nFisher OR 51.9, p = 1.1e-15",ha="center",fontsize=9)
axA.text(100,0.95,"Truncating P/LP variants span codons 3-196 (median 103), n = 64",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,style="italic")
axA.set_xlim(-6,215); axA.set_ylim(0,1.12); axA.axis("off")
axA.set_title("A.  TWIST1 (202 aa, HGNC:12428, Q15672): pathogenic missense is a bHLH-domain phenomenon",
              fontsize=11,loc="left",weight="bold")

# --- Panel B: panel diagnostic yield ---
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
d=pd.DataFrame([("EFNB1",381,203),("IL11RA",220,103),("TWIST1",363,159),("RUNX2",750,222),
                ("TCF12",656,175),("FGFR1",1480,315),("ERF",355,75),("FGFR2",1066,185),
                ("FGFR3",1558,229),("SMAD6",1418,97)],columns=["g","n","p"])
d["pct"]=100*d.p/d.n; d=d.sort_values("pct")
axB.barh(range(len(d)),d.pct,color=["#b2182b" if g=="TWIST1" else "#9ecae1" for g in d.g],ec="k",lw=.4)
axB.set_yticks(range(len(d))); axB.set_yticklabels(d.g,fontsize=9)
axB.axvline(21.5,ls="--",c="grey"); axB.set_xlabel("% of ClinVar records P/LP")
axB.set_title("B.  TWIST1 43.8% vs core panel 21.5%\nOR 2.84, p = 7.3e-20",fontsize=10,loc="left",weight="bold")

# --- Panel C: CNV sizes ---
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
loss=[0.29,2.1,4.0,6.0,7.8,12.5,28.0,159.23]; gain=[9.93,18.0,22.0,25.0,27.3,30.0,36.0,41.82]
rs=np.random.RandomState(1)
axC.scatter(loss,np.zeros(len(loss))+rs.uniform(-.1,.1,len(loss)),c="#b2182b",s=70,ec="k",lw=.4,label="loss")
axC.scatter(gain,np.ones(len(gain))+rs.uniform(-.1,.1,len(gain)),c="#2166ac",s=70,ec="k",lw=.4,label="gain")
axC.axvline(0.0966,ls="--",c="k",lw=1.3)
axC.text(0.105,1.42,"TWIST1 = 96.6 kb",fontsize=8)
axC.set_xscale("log"); axC.set_yticks([0,1]); axC.set_yticklabels(["loss","gain"])
axC.set_xlabel("CNV size (Mb, log)")
axC.set_title("C.  No pathogenic CNV isolates TWIST1\nmedian 18.3 Mb, all contain whole gene",fontsize=10,loc="left",weight="bold")

plt.suptitle("TWIST1-related craniosynostosis (MONDO:0007399 / OMIM:123100): variant architecture and evidence base",
             fontsize=12.5,y=0.985)
plt.show()
print("Panel A n=44 P/LP missense, 42 in bHLH; Panel B n=10 genes; Panel C n=16 sized P/LP CNVs")
